title: Monitor Evasion Under Prompt Injection: Do AI Monitors Fail When the Agent's Input Is Adversarial?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If monitors are trivially evadable by environmental prompt injections, the entire monitoring paradigm is fragile. Documenting this failure mode and testing basic defenses has immediate and fundamental impact on monitoring architecture design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating prompt injection test cases is creative work but does not require advanced ML. Running monitors on modified environments is API-level work. Testing defenses (paraphrasing, ensembling) is straightforward. Accessible to CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 20 test cases is manageable. The deliverable is clear: detection rate drop measurement and defense evaluation. Could be tightened to 10 test cases and 1 defense. Feasible within 30 hours.
